mechanism: Lisdexamfetamine is a prodrug of amphetamine which increases sympathomimetic activity; combined with isocarboxazid (MAOI) causes excessive noradrenergic and serotonergic activity leading to hypertensive crisis and serotonin syndrome.
action: Contraindicated combination - do not use together; maintain at least 14 days washout between discontinuing MAOI and starting lisdexamfetamine or vice versa.
